summary: R122-based German Paper 20 source-audit webdrop for printed pp.26-33. It applies one source-certain TeX correction to the decomposition-display tag before formula (13), changing an R122 editorial tag (12 prime) back to the source-visible tag (12), and packages 1000 dpi formula witnesses plus checked-no-patch ledgers.

Confirmed one source-certain correction on printed p31: tag (12 prime) to source tag (12).
Checked formulas (1)-(14) and recorded several no-patch dispositions for pp.27-31.

XeLaTeX produced a 457-page German cumulative candidate PDF; the package reports no fatal errors, undefined control sequences, missing characters, unresolved references, rerun warnings, overfull/underfull hboxes, or duplicate-destination warnings.
limitations: Candidate review package only; not a promoted canonical branch unless later accepted/reconciled.
Paper 20 printed pp.26-33 only; does not certify surrounding Noether papers or downstream translations.
No English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic synchronization is included.
The local witness-only wrapper Noether_R122_P20_SourceAudit_Witness_20260624.zip is superseded by this fuller webdrop for public staging purposes.
Not a critical edition, not whole-corpus certification, and not final Noether closure.
recommended_next_action: Review and reconcile the one-line source tag correction into the current German branch before any multilingual propagation; retain the 1000 dpi crops as visual audit support for Paper 20 formulas (1)-(14).
